content: Microkernel plugin architecture: minimal core handles essential operations, plugins extend functionality without modifying core. Key elements: Plugin Interface (well-defined contract), Plugin Registry (discovery/loading), Extension Points (hook locations). Isolation: each plugin independent, can be tested/developed/deployed separately. Communication via IPC or message bus. For IoT: hardware tiles with Trusted Communication Units for physical isolation. Avoid: plugin interdependencies, complex initialization order, core that becomes dumping ground.
